title: Pandolfi email: senators let him carry the keys

tellings.quote: Ron, there's even an email I have where Ron says uh these senators and congressmen, they're they're always uh asking these questions and they they don't realize that it's it's not the material, it's the access to the material and you can get in a lot of trouble and I tell the senators that and they just let me carry the keys.

plain: Ron Pandolfi, a CIA scientist, wrote in an email that senators and congressmen keep asking questions without understanding that the issue is "not the material, it's the access to the material," that "you can get in a lot of trouble," and that when he tells them so "they just let me carry the keys." The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says he has this email and tells Michels about it. Cameron reads it as Pandolfi holding the access to UFO secrets, while the words quoted say only that lawmakers left access in his hands, not what lies behind it.
